Samsung Galaxy S24

Samsung has detailed the September 2026 security patch for Galaxy smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches. It addresses a total of 90 security vulnerabilities.

Of these 90 fixes, 58 originate from Google, one from Samsung Semiconductor, and 31 from Samsung Mobile. The brand should start rolling it out to eligible devices soon.
